propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs advance to 99% progress then emit nothing for 1.7–4.3 hours until manual cancellation, blocking the runner queue and later runs.
The _build-and-test.yml reusable workflow test job lacks a timeout-minutes configuration, defaulting to GitHub's 360-minute limit instead of the documented 10–16 minute normal execution duration.

Stale Gerrit patchsets 1129/1130/1131/1136 omit the fix commit 96a0d5c3f and retain blob:none filter with lazy-fetch checkout-index, causing per-blob sequential RPC fetches that project to ~2.1 hours on CI partial clones.

FakeJiraClient.search_issues in test_jira_dc_transport.py ignored startAt/maxResults pagination parameters, causing test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract to loop infinitely and timeout when called through _paged_search on Gerrit 1129.
